answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the quartz of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the walnut re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
